meaning: Execute complete source-derived composition cases against strictly compiled, independently audited native computation modules with exact run-local evidence custody.
ownership: Construct an immutable process-registered control from the registered graph and plan, pinned binding/reference/cases/effects/controls definitions and exact selected source artifacts. No caller-supplied executable oracle or arbitrary audit receipt authorizes execution. The private executor owns compilation and both AST audit calls. Public source replay, source filesystem currentness and whole-project accounting remain parent integration obligations.
execution: Materialize only the checked behavior.mjs, Calculation adapter, selected Calculation wrappers and arithmetic providers. Compile strictly as NodeNext ESM with TypeScript 7.0.2 and the explicit Node type root; preserve generated JavaScript unchanged. Audit the complete computation closure in source and native phases and compare every observed path, hash, import, alias, export and violation against the independent binding before importing target code. Structural record bridges execute no factory. No HTTP endpoint, transport, database or operational provider is loaded.
runner: The trusted runner receives exact run input and script hashes out of band. Input contains binding/control identities, exact native module hashes and paths, and complete input/request cases, but no expected answers. Use fresh decoded inert roots per case; capture ordered observations and outcomes with the tagged structural value protocol. Compare input before and after and reject target mutation. Wire/capture exhaustion and unexpected runner errors invalidate the entire observation, never become a passing domain failure or partial prefix.
resources: Use a fresh caller-owned empty workspace with normalized absolute nonsymbolic paths, exclusive file creation and bounded regular reads. Bound the whole source/native computation closure to 64 MiB per phase and each artifact to 8 MiB; runner input to 16 MiB, complete observed output to 16 MiB, native subprocess output to 32 MiB, execution to 60 seconds per subprocess and Node target heap to 256 MiB. Maximum 4095 cases. Execute target Node with filesystem-read permission restricted to the owned runner/input/module tree, disabled prototype access, no granted writes, child processes or workers, and a minimal environment without inherited credentials. Node permissions and syntactic audits are defense in depth, not a universal arbitrary-code sandbox.
custody: Bind source artifacts, compiler configuration, module package metadata, audit script, exact audit inputs and outputs, native modules, runner, case input and observation output. Check the exact file/directory inventory and immutable expected bytes before/after each audit and execution. Recheck selected Node/compiler/API/AST/type-manifest fingerprints and registered graph/plan identity at the end. Extra, missing, replaced, symbolic or late-mutated artifacts fail. Successful evidence is process-registered and may be revalidated against retained workspace bytes; hashes are integrity evidence, not authenticity or authority.
outcomes: Success requires every case ID exactly once in original order, exact request-derived native outcome and ordered observations matching independent source expectations, unchanged inputs, complete audits and final custody. Expected domain failures retain their error codes and full traces. No not-evaluable source family is silently dropped. Runtime failure retains its causal phase and does not return a passing prefix.
verification: Exercise actual source/native audits and restricted native behavior with clean Calculation and no-Calculation fixtures. Execute audit-permitted compiling semantic mutations and show disagreement with source cases; reject binding/effect mutants before execution. Test malformed or changed runner inputs, substitutions, artifact inventories, permission boundaries, finite capacities and late evidence drift. Preserve predecessor modules and additive proof registration.
claim_ceiling: Private finite native controls only. Public composition verification, entry-point wiring, complete project replay/currentness, capsule registration and all remaining R08-R18 remain required. No product semantic changes, approval, admission, default cutover, installation, publication or release.
